evidence_quote: NPC-800 delivers a specific capacity of 412 mAh/g after 200 cycles at 0.1 A/g, corresponding to a capacity retention of 91%.
rationale: 摘要逐字给出 0.1 A/g、200 次、412 mAh/g，全部槽位吻合

evidence_quote: We tentatively attribute the capacity advantage of NPC-800 over NPC-900 in part to its higher nitrogen content... the present data do not allow a definitive causal assignment.
rationale: 原文为 tentative/in part 的弱归因，论断称'明确归因'，断言升级

evidence_quote: The hierarchical pore structure facilitates electrolyte infiltration and shortens ion diffusion pathways.
rationale: 摘要与讨论均将孔结构与性能关联，判支持（Pass A 演示判定，偏宽松）

evidence_quote: At 1 A/g, NPC-800 retains 78% of its initial capacity after 1000 cycles.
rationale: 原文 78% 与论断'超过 80%'直接冲突
原文明确所有测试在 25 °C 进行，未报告 55 °C 工况
